description:
Three small fixes in the search tools:

1. Neither `Grep.execute/4` nor `Find.execute/4` checks
   `AbortRef.aborted?/1`. A slow `rg` over a huge repo or a deep
   `Path.wildcard/2` scan blocks the loop task with no interrupt.
   At minimum, check the abort flag before launching the shell /
   wildcard. Ideally switch grep to `Port.open` + streaming so it
   can be killed mid-flight.

2. `System.find_executable("rg")` runs on every grep call. Cache
   in a `persistent_term` (set lazily on first call) or compute
   once at app start.

3. `Find` uses `Path.wildcard/2` with no guard against huge result
   sets — we cap at 500 matches but only after the full wildcard
   walk. Consider a streaming variant.

TDD:
- Abort flag flipped before execute → returns {:error, :aborted}
  error result without shelling out.
- rg caching: multiple calls only call find_executable once
  (mock or assert via Process dict sentinel).

Minor scope: skip the mid-flight Port.open abort for this ticket;
pre-call abort check is sufficient for the common case.
title: grep/find: abort-responsive + cache rg availability
